## Checklist
- [ ] I followed the repo architecture and instruction files.
- [ ] I kept handlers/controllers thin and reusable logic extracted.
- [ ] I preserved tenant isolation and reviewed auth/authorization impact.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for all new/changed behavior.
- [ ] Coverage for new/changed code is 80% or higher.
- [ ] No function/method exceeds cognitive complexity 15.
- [ ] I reviewed duplication and extracted shared code where appropriate.
- [ ] I updated docs/contracts if payloads, node config, or graph behavior changed.
- [ ] Lint, test, build, and Sonar checks pass locally or in CI.
